serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
I guess it’s fine to let them go.
Shanice seems to know a lot about skating so I can entrust {f_botName} to her for a while.
Maybe that stubborn bot will learn a thing or two…
…
They are going kinda fast…
You: Shanice! Could you go a bit slower?
Shanice: No way! We are having fun here!
…
Shanice: We are back in one piece!
Bot: I think my gyroscopes need recalibrating…
Shanice: Haha! Was it perhaps a little too fast for you?
Bot: You are a dangerous girl Shanice…{{wi}} I need to raise your threat level…
Shanice: What the heck is that?!
Shanice: You are one funny girl, you know that?
Bot: I wasn’t joking…
You: I don’t know about you, but I’m tired.
Shanice: Alright then! Let’s end for today and the next time we will do something a little more crazy!
Bot: Is that even possible?
You: Thanks for today and see you later!
